answer.explanation: The proposed trade plan rebalances the portfolio to meet all asset allocation targets within the allowable ±0.5% tolerance while complying with all investment restrictions. Selling 38 shares of MSFT ($15,200) and 50 shares of NVDA ($10,000) generates $25,200 in cash while keeping AAPL untouched. Purchasing 125 shares of BND ($10,000) and 10 shares of VOO ($5,000) uses $15,000, leaving $10,200 (10.2%) in cash. Post-rebalance allocations are Stock at 59.8% ($59,800), Bond at 30.0% ($30,000), and Cash at 10.2% ($10,200). Direct technology sector exposure (AAPL + MSFT) is brought down to 34.8% ($34,800), satisfying the 35% cap, and all individual stock positions remain below the 25% individual maximum.
